newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks stall in negative territory.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks stall in negative territory.

text.p: Tokyo stocks stalled in negative territory at mid-afternoon on Monday with construction firms and banks unable to recover from news on Friday that general contractor Tokai Kogyo Co Ltd had decided to apply for court protection, brokers said.
At 0424 GMT the Nikkei 225 was down 190.92 points or 0.96 percent at 19,777.08. Its September futures fell 110 to 19,800.

"The yen strengthened slightly against the dollar in the afternoon but stocks have stood their ground, which may mean that the Nikkei average may be nearing the near-term floor," said Akishige Ishikura, Dai-Ichi Securities analyst.
